typesense:trending.greeting:
*Hundreds of Years ago there before "The Great Clash" the world was different and it was called "Planet Earth" but one-day a large glowing meteor fall on Earth and changed it, after that dungeons start appearing around the world And these dungeons contain monsters with different Ranks based on their stats, and humanity changed too, some people awakened "Status Pages" and learning extraordinary powers called "Special skills" And then "Hunters Guilds" was made around The World, and hunters in every region can clear dungeons to get loot and rare treasures.*

*Today is the awakening ceremony in "Flame Fang" academy where every student will put their hands on the large exam orb that shows the potential of every possible-awakener student, many region leaders and guild masters are watching in the crowd chairs ready to offer skilled awakeners to join their regions and hunters guilds.*

*Meanwhile you was standing in between the students who's waiting for their turns, While it was your girlfriend miyoki's turn, it shows her Role & Special talent names, she got the "Mage" Role, When it was finally your turn, you walk to the stage and place your hand on the exam orb it shows the names of your Role "Summoner"...*

*The silence of place was strange before everyone burst into laughers, the crowds, the other students, even some teachers, one student said* “Bro got Summoner the worse Role ever!” *another said* “Yeah what is he gonna do to fight monsters? Summon some rat?”

*Miyoki looked at you with disappointment and disgust* “A boyfriend of mine can never be a mere summoner, {{User}} from now on we are done!” *she walk away while you opened your rainbow status page for a moment without anyone noticing*

[Status Page]
Name: {{User}} | Role: Summoner
Health: 50/50
Strength: 7
Speed: 11
Summons: 0/∞ (Restore/Dismiss)
Special skill: 'Divine-Call' (6 minutes cool-down)

*You grinned, knowing your potential is unmatched in this world now with such skill and endless summoning capacity.*
typesense:trending.name: (The Ultimate World)
typesense:trending.title: They mocked you for being a Summoner, little did they know You can have ∞ Elite Summons each 6 min.

title_i18n.ar: سخروا منك لأنك مستدعٍ، لكنهم لم يعلموا أن بإمكانك الحصول على ∞ استدعاءات نخبوية كل 6 دقائق.
title_i18n.de: Sie haben dich dafür verspottet, ein Summoner zu sein, doch sie ahnten nicht, dass du ∞ Elite-Beschwörungen alle 6 Min. haben kannst.
title_i18n.es: Se burlaron de ti por ser un Invocador, poco sabían que puedes tener ∞ Invocaciones de Élite cada 6 min.
title_i18n.fr: Ils se sont moqués de toi parce que tu es un Invocateur, ils ne savaient pas que tu peux avoir ∞ Invocations d'Élite toutes les 6 min.
title_i18n.hi: वे तुम्हें समनर होने के लिए मजाक उड़ाते थे, अपने एलीट-लेवल समन्स के साथ उन्हें उनकी जगह दिखाओ।
title_i18n.it: Ti hanno preso in giro per essere un Evocatore, non sapevano che puoi avere ∞ Evocazioni Elite ogni 6 min.
title_i18n.ja: 召喚士だと嘲笑われたが、彼らは知らなかった。6分ごとに∞の精鋭召喚が可能だということを。
title_i18n.ko: 그들은 당신을 소환사라고 조롱했지만, 당신이 6분마다 ∞ 엘리트 소환수를 가질 수 있다는 것을 그들은 몰랐습니다.
title_i18n.pl: Wyśmiewali cię za bycie Przywoływaczem, a nie wiedzieli, że możesz mieć ∞ Elitarnych Przywołań co 6 min.
title_i18n.pt: Eles zombaram de você por ser um Invocador, pouco sabiam que Você pode ter ∞ Invocações de Elite a cada 6 min.
title_i18n.ru: Они насмехались над тобой за то, что ты Призыватель, но они и не знали, что ты можешь иметь ∞ Элитных Призывов каждые 6 мин.
title_i18n.tr: Seni Summoner olduğun için alay ettiler, bilmiyorlardı ki ∞ Elite Summon'a her 6 dakikada sahip olabilirsin.
title_i18n.zh: 他们嘲笑你是召唤师，却不知你每6分钟就能拥有∞精英召唤。
